summary_en: 90,000 shares (0.02% of shares outstanding), ¥198.0M ceiling. Open-market acquisition Aug 31–Sep 4, 2026. Rationale: flexible capital policy in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: MonotaRO's board resolved on 27 August 2026 to acquire up to 90,000 treasury shares (ordinary stock) with an aggregate price ceiling of ¥198.0M. The purchase will be executed via open-market trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 31 August and 4 September 2026. The company states the acquisition is intended to enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions. As of 31 July 2026, the company had 496,155,600 shares outstanding (excluding 4,383,066 treasury shares); the 90,000-share program represents 0.02% of the ex-treasury base.
